CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. Which response best shows understanding of Raising the Widow’s Son? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Raising the Widow’s Son with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Raising the Widow’s Son has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Raising the Widow’s Son to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Raising the Widow’s Son.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T.
   B. Use Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Nicodemus Encounter with Jesus Christ 8 3.5 Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 T has no place in daily life.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

6. Which response best shows understanding of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes.
   C. Say Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Parable on prayer Midnight? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Parable on prayer Midnight with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Parable on prayer Midnight to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Parable on prayer Midnight has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Parable on prayer Midnight.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Christian Moral Values: Purity? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian Moral Values: Purity.
   B. Say Christian Moral Values: Purity has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Christian Moral Values: Purity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Christian Moral Values: Purity to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Say Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem.
   C. Use Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus’ Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Kings David and Solomon? (1 mark)
   A. Use Kings David and Solomon to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kings David and Solomon.
   C. Apply the teaching of Kings David and Solomon with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Kings David and Solomon has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Work: God Worked? (1 mark)
   A. Use Work: God Worked to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Work: God Worked with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Work: God Worked has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work: God Worked.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif.
   C. Say Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem 10 4.0 The Church 4.1 The Early Church 8 4.2 The Gif to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kings David and Solomon and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Raising the Widow’s Son and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Healing the 10 Lepers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
